articles.summary: With Makani's discontinuation we make use of their data open-sourcing and reflect on their achievements, possible mistakes, and our interpretation and anticipation of them.
articles.title: Taking over the Baton from Makani

articles.summary: We are thrilled to announce that we have reached a major milestone in our development towards our first 100kW product with a successful flight in all phases. The flight was fully autonomous apart from giving high level commands to launch and land.
articles.title: Kitekraft succeeds with autonomous all phase flight of new kite demonstrator
